wiki_text: In September 2025, Japanese energy company JERA Co., Inc. signed a memorandum of understanding with Montenegrin authorities to conduct a feasibility study on an LNG terminal at Bar. The MOU (announced 11 September 2025) commits JERA only to a joint feasibility study -- it does not establish an equity stake, ownership change, specific capacity figure, or a committed project timeline. Montenegro's Energy Minister welcomed the study as a step toward diversifying gas supply. This appears to run in parallel to the pre-existing LNG Alliance/EPCG-sponsored 0.40 mtpa proposed Bar LNG Terminal already in GEM's record -- it is not yet clear from public reporting whether JERA's study targets the same proposed project or a separate site/concept at Bar. No Owner, Parent, Status, or Capacity change is staged from this MOU alone -- an MOU/feasibility-study commitment does not meet the bar for FID or construction-stage status, and no specific capacity or financial commitment has been publicly disclosed. If a future update finds JERA taking a project stake, note that GEM's entity system already carries both a parent 'JERA' (100000001533) and a near-duplicate operating-subsidiary-style entity 'JERA Co' (100002025198) -- the September 2025 MOU was signed by the entity named 'JERA Co., Inc.', which maps most closely to the existing 'JERA Co' entity; confirm against Postgres before staging either.

source_urls.title: JERA Signs MOU for Montenegro LNG Terminal
